description: Somo hili linafundisha ngeli mbalimbali za nomino za Kiswahili na upatanisho wa kisarufi baina ya nomino, vitenzi na vivumishi.

mcq.explanation: Words for people such as 'mwalimu' (teacher) belong to the A-WA class, whose plural is 'walimu'.
'Kiti' is in the KI-VI class, so its plural changes 'ki-' to 'vi-', giving 'viti'.

mcq.questionText: Ni sentensi ipi iliyo na upatanisho sahihi wa kisarufi?
mcq.explanation: 'Watoto' is plural in the A-WA class, so it takes the subject prefix 'wa-' on the verb: 'wanacheza'.

mcq.questionText: Nomino 'kitabu' na 'meza' zimo katika ngeli zipi mtawalia?
mcq.explanation: 'Kitabu' is KI-VI (plural 'vitabu') while 'meza' is I-ZI, keeping the same form in singular and plural.

mcq.questionText: Wingi sahihi wa nomino 'ukuta' ni upi?
mcq.explanation: 'Ukuta' is in the U-ZI class, so its plural drops the 'u-', giving 'kuta'.

mcq.questionText: Sentensi 'Gari ______ haraka' ikamilike vipi kwa upatanisho sahihi?
mcq.explanation: 'Gari' is in the LI-YA class, so the singular subject prefix is 'li-', giving 'linakwenda'.

mcq.questionText: Nomino 'mti' iko katika ngeli ya U-I. Wingi wake ni upi?
mcq.explanation: In the U-I class the prefix 'm-/mw-' changes to 'mi-' in the plural, so 'mti' becomes 'miti'.

mcq.questionText: Kivumishi 'zuri' kinachukua kiambishi kipi kwa nomino 'watoto'?
mcq.explanation: 'Watoto' is plural A-WA, so the adjective agrees with the 'wa-' prefix, giving 'wazuri'.

mcq.questionText: Ni nomino ipi iliyo katika ngeli ya PA-KU-MU?
mcq.explanation: The PA-KU-MU class expresses location, and 'mahali' (place) is its main noun.
'Jicho' is in the LI-YA class and forms its plural irregularly as 'macho'.
'Vitabu' is plural KI-VI, so the locative copula agrees as 'viko'.

mcq.questionText: Nomino 'wimbo' (wingi: nyimbo) iko katika ngeli gani?
mcq.explanation: 'Wimbo' takes 'u-' in the singular and 'nyi-' in the plural ('nyimbo'), which is typical of the U-ZI class.

mcq.questionText: Ni sentensi ipi yenye upatanisho sahihi wa ngeli ya I-ZI?
mcq.explanation: Plural nouns in the I-ZI class take the subject prefix 'zi-', so 'nyumba zinapendeza' is correct.

mcq.questionText: Nomino 'uhuru' ni nomino dhahania. Iko katika ngeli ipi?
mcq.explanation: Abstract nouns beginning with 'u-' that have no plural, like 'uhuru', are placed in the U-YA class.

mcq.questionText: Kivumishi 'kingine' kinaambatana na nomino ipi kwa usahihi?
mcq.explanation: 'Kingine' carries the KI-VI singular prefix 'ki-', so it agrees with a KI-VI noun like 'kikombe'.

fib.explanation: Nouns referring to people, such as 'mtoto', belong to the A-WA class.
'Kisu' is KI-VI, so the prefix changes from 'ki-' to 'vi-' in the plural.

fib.questionText: Sentensi: Mwanafunzi _____ darasani jana. (kuwepo, wakati uliopita)
fib.explanation: 'Mwanafunzi' is singular A-WA, so it takes the prefix 'a-' giving 'alikuwepo'.
'Mlima' is in the U-I class, so 'm-' becomes 'mi-' in the plural.

fib.questionText: Sentensi: Magari _____ barabarani. (kuwa mahali, wakati uliopo)
fib.explanation: 'Magari' is plural LI-YA, so the locative copula agrees as 'yako'.
'Ufunguo' is in the U-ZI class, dropping 'u-' to form the plural 'funguo'.

fib.questionText: Sentensi: Chakula _____ kitamu sana. (kuwa, wakati uliopo)
fib.explanation: 'Chakula' is in the KI-VI class (singular), so it takes the prefix 'ki-'.

fib.questionText: Nomino 'wema' ni nomino dhahania iliyo katika ngeli ya _____.
fib.explanation: Abstract nouns with 'u-' that lack a plural, like 'wema', are in the U-YA class.

fib.questionText: Sentensi: Nyota _____ angani usiku. (kuonekana, wingi, wakati uliopo)
fib.explanation: 'Nyota' (plural) is in the I-ZI class, taking the subject prefix 'zi-'.

fib.questionText: Sentensi: Mahali hapa _____ pazuri kwa kupumzika. (kuwa, wakati uliopo)
fib.explanation: 'Mahali' is in the PA-KU-MU class, taking the locative prefix 'pa-'.

tf.questionText: Nomino 'mama' iko katika ngeli ya A-WA ingawa haianzi na 'm-' ya kawaida.
tf.explanation: Kinship and person nouns like 'mama' belong to A-WA regardless of their shape, with plural 'mama' or 'akina mama'.
'Kikapu' is KI-VI, so its correct plural is 'vikapu', not 'makikapu'.

tf.questionText: Nomino za ngeli ya I-ZI mara nyingi hazibadiliki umbo kati ya umoja na wingi.
tf.explanation: Many I-ZI nouns such as 'nyumba' and 'kalamu' have the same form in singular and plural.

tf.questionText: Sentensi 'Kitabu inasomwa' ina upatanisho sahihi wa kisarufi.
tf.explanation: 'Kitabu' is KI-VI singular and must take 'ki-': the correct form is 'Kitabu kinasomwa'.

tf.questionText: Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU hutumika kuonyesha mahali au eneo.
tf.explanation: The PA-KU-MU class is the locative class, expressing definite, general and internal place.
'Ndege' is an I-ZI noun that does not change form between singular and plural.

tf.questionText: Nomino 'tunda' na wingi wake 'matunda' viko katika ngeli ya LI-YA.
tf.explanation: 'Tunda' (plural 'matunda') follows the LI-YA pattern of singular without 'ma-' and plural with 'ma-'.
'Miti' is plural U-I, so the adjective agrees with the 'mi-' prefix, giving 'mizuri'.

tf.questionText: Nomino dhahania kama 'upendo' huwa na wingi wa kawaida kama 'mapendo'.
tf.explanation: Abstract nouns like 'upendo' in the U-YA class normally have no plural form.

tf.questionText: Sentensi 'Walimu wanafundisha' ina upatanisho sahihi wa ngeli ya A-WA.
tf.explanation: 'Walimu' is plural A-WA, correctly agreeing with the verb prefix 'wa-' in 'wanafundisha'.

summary.correctAnswer: Ni makundi ya nomino yanayofanana kimaumbo na kiupatanisho wa kisarufi.
summary.explanation: A noun class groups nouns that share prefixes and trigger the same grammatical agreement.

summary.questionText: Ngeli ya A-WA hujumuisha nomino za aina gani?
summary.correctAnswer: Nomino zinazotaja watu na baadhi ya viumbe hai.
summary.explanation: The A-WA class mainly contains nouns referring to people and some living beings.

summary.questionText: Ngeli ya KI-VI hubadilishaje umoja kwenda wingi?
summary.explanation: KI-VI nouns shift the singular 'ki-' prefix to 'vi-' for the plural.

summary.questionText: Ngeli ya U-I huonyesha mabadiliko gani ya kiambishi?
summary.correctAnswer: Kiambishi 'm-/mw-' cha umoja hubadilika kuwa 'mi-' katika wingi.
summary.explanation: U-I nouns change the singular 'm-/mw-' prefix to 'mi-' in the plural, as in 'mti/miti'.

summary.questionText: Ngeli ya LI-YA hutumia viambishi gani vya umoja na wingi?
summary.explanation: LI-YA nouns trigger the subject prefix 'li-' in the singular and 'ya-' in the plural.

summary.questionText: Ngeli ya I-ZI hutumia viambishi gani vya kitenzi?
summary.explanation: I-ZI nouns take the verb prefix 'i-' for singular and 'zi-' for plural.

summary.correctAnswer: Ni ulinganifu wa viambishi kati ya nomino na vitenzi au vivumishi kulingana na ngeli.
summary.explanation: Grammatical agreement is the matching of affixes on verbs and adjectives to the noun's class.

summary.questionText: Ngeli ya U-ZI hubadilishaje umoja kwenda wingi?
summary.correctAnswer: Nomino za 'u-' hubadilika kuwa 'kuta/nyimbo/funguo' kwa kuondoa au kubadili kiambishi.
summary.explanation: U-ZI singular 'u-' nouns form plurals by dropping or changing the prefix, e.g. 'ukuta/kuta'.

summary.questionText: Ngeli ya U-YA hujumuisha nomino za aina gani?
summary.correctAnswer: Nomino dhahania zisizo na wingi kama 'uhuru' na 'upendo'.
summary.explanation: The U-YA class holds abstract nouns that generally have no plural.

summary.questionText: Ngeli ya PA-KU-MU hutumika kwa nini?
summary.correctAnswer: Hutumika kuonyesha mahali kupitia viambishi 'pa-', 'ku-', na 'mu-'.
summary.explanation: The PA-KU-MU class marks location using the prefixes pa-, ku- and mu-.

hoq.questionText: Andika sentensi sahihi: 'Mtoto na mbwa wake ______ bustanini'. Chagua kitenzi chenye upatanisho sahihi kwa nomino mbili za ngeli ya A-WA.
hoq.explanation: Two A-WA subjects joined by 'na' form a plural, so the verb takes the plural prefix 'wa-' giving 'wanacheza'.

hoq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Kitabu changu kimepotea', kivumishi 'changu' na kitenzi 'kimepotea' vinathibitisha kuwa 'kitabu' kiko katika ngeli ipi, na kwa nini?

options.text: KI-VI, kwa sababu vivumishi na vitenzi vinachukua kiambishi 'ki-'

hoq.explanation: Both the possessive 'changu' and the verb 'kimepotea' carry the 'ki-' agreement, confirming the KI-VI class.

hoq.questionText: Geuza sentensi 'Mti mrefu unakua haraka' kuwa wingi kwa upatanisho kamili wa ngeli ya U-I.
hoq.explanation: In U-I plural, the noun, adjective and verb all take 'mi-/i-' agreement: 'Miti mirefu inakua haraka'.
